name: Source-transfer failure indication
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Reports that a required feedback or completion condition was not achieved during transfer.
description: Reports that a required feedback or completion condition was not achieved during transfer. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Transfer request and feedback” at the input and “Transfer-failed alarm” at the output. The alarm does not prescribe a recovery sequence.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible.
